# Ryujinx shader translator (vendored subset)

Source subset of three projects from Ryujinx 1.3.2: `Ryujinx.Graphics.Shader`, `Ryujinx.Common` and `Spv.Generator`.
The shader translation tool in `tools/shader_translate` references them to translate the original Switch shaders to SPIR-V.
License: MIT, see `LICENSE.txt`. Upstream: <https://github.com/Ryubing>.

The unused application-title catalog is omitted from this distribution.
